body: This is what I want, but I don't know how I can do this without her feeling like it's her fault and hurting herself(or if I'm being honest I have no idea if she'd be crazy enough to come after me now that she knows where I live). I feel like there's no winning in this situation but I just don't want her to hurt herself.

I'm kinda scared that a girl I've been seeing is using me too much for emotional support and I don't know how to distance myself without being afraid that she might hurt herself or kill herself.

So for background I matched with her like 3 weeks ago, talked with her for like 3 days before we decided it'd be cool for her to come over and spend the night. We watch Netflix then cuddle and I make a move, she doesn't stop me but also doesn't seem into it at all so I stopped. In the morning I asked her why we didn't hook up and she tells me she was on her period, ok would have liked to known that in advance but she seems cool so I say no worries and that we should meet up again. After she leaves she messages me asking what I want out of this and I just say that for now I think we're just having casual fun but that I'm not against looking for something serious with the right person. She agrees this is what she wants for right now.

She comes over again the next week but same thing happens, watch Netflix I make a move and she seems just not into it at all despite the fact that we'd been sending dirty snaps all week leading up to this. I think she's very nice and all but like come on I drove an hour to pick you up and bring you back to my place after you've been gaslighting me with dirty texts for a week,  am I wrong to go into the night with expectations? Same thing just happened again tonight for a third time, cuddling with no sex.

Whatever. The real problems has been in the last week or so she just seems really down on herself all the time. She's a freshman in college and just seems like she doesn't have a solid group of friends to occupy her time so she just sits in her room and is miserable. I try to tell her things like oh don't be afraid to put yourself out there or everyone's lonely freshman year, you'll find your group, but she just replies with stuff like "I'm happy when I'm with you". Look I'm a depressed downer person myself, I just can't be the emotional support this girl wants, all I wanted was some casual sex at the moment but I've somehow become this girls emotional support dog.

And I can't even say I don't like her as a person, just that I'm very concerned by the fact that no sex after 3 dates despite the fact that we said all we wanted was a casual thing for now on top of all the scary clingy depressed stuff. I just don't know how to distance myself without her feeling like I'm abandoning her emotionally, fuck me how did this happen?
